name: extreme analysis
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 研究响应最大或最小状态及其统计特征的分析。
usage_overview: 用于从不同轨道不平顺样本激起的动力响应中识别上、下极值，并与实测结果比较，以考察不平顺随机变化下系统响应的极端状态。

complete_examples.text: As the extended applications, the extreme analysis, dynamic reliability and response relationships between dynamic indices will be further illustrated and validated.

In this section, three numerical examples, including extreme analysis, dynamic reliability analysis and response relationships analysis, are presented to illustrate the extended applications of the proposed models.
